test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2nd December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The 'PRANA' portal was launched by the Central Government in September 2021.

'PRANA' is the acronym for ____.

options.text: Portal for Regulation of Air-pollution in Non-Attainment Cities
Programme for Regulation of Air-polluted and Non-Polluted Cities
Portal for Registration of Air-polluted and Non-Polluted Areas
Programme for Rating of Air-polluted and Non-polluted Areas

solution: The correct answer is __**Portal for Regulation of Air-pollution in Non-Attainment Cities.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**</p&
